The travel journal

Take the scenic route. Always.

Our favourite journeys are about more than ticking places off a list. They’re about the early starts, the unexpected turns, the food we remember, the views that make us pause, and the people who make a place feel alive.

Through The Far Mile, we share travel videos and inspiration to help you plan your own explorations—starting close to home and going wherever curiosity leads.

  • Local places and regional culture
  • Scenic escapes and memorable road trips
  • Travel visuals, stories and practical inspiration

The people behind the miles

Two travellers.
One shared story.

We are Radha Mohan Rath and Ushashree Rath, the owners and creators behind The Far Mile. This brand is our way of celebrating travel—the wonder of discovering somewhere new, the beauty of our own Odisha, and the memories we collect along the way.

We believe every place has a story, whether it’s a famous landmark or a quiet corner you stumble upon. We’re glad you’re here, and we’d love for you to travel with us.
